title: ReliaGuard: Reconstruction-Aware Watermarking for Source Attribution and Blind Edit Localization
abstract: arXiv:2611.16368v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative image editing facilitates content creation but complicates source attribution and edit verification. Existing watermarking methods combine copyright protection with tamper localization, yet background reconstruction can weaken spatial evidence even when source identifiers remain recoverable. We propose ReliaGuard, a reconstruction-aware watermarking framework for source attribution and blind edit localization. The writer optimizes keyed feature responses in both the protected image and its variational autoencoder reconstruction under image-distortion and source-preservation constraints. Using only the received image and a secret key, the reader combines watermark responses with local image context through residual evidence refinement and predicts an edit mask through native-resolution-guided multiscale reading. translated_title: ReliaGuard：面向来源归属与盲编辑定位的重构感知水印框架
translated_abstract: 生成式图像编辑促进了内容创作，但也使来源归属和编辑验证变得复杂。现有的水印方法将版权保护与篡改定位相结合，然而即使源标识符仍然可以恢复，背景重构也可能削弱空间证据。我们提出了ReliaGuard，一个面向来源归属和盲编辑定位的重构感知水印框架。写入器在图像失真约束和源保留约束下，同时在受保护图像及其变分自编码器（VAE）重构上优化密钥化特征响应。读取器仅利用接收到的图像和秘密密钥，通过残差证据精炼将水印响应与局部图像上下文相结合，并通过原生分辨率引导的多尺度读取预测编辑掩码。该框架在完整的编辑输出、局部拼接的对应图像以及两者的处理后版本上进行训练。在一个独立的（原文在此处截断）
tldr: ReliaGuard提出了一种重构感知的水印框架，通过在受保护图像及其VAE重构上联合优化密钥化特征响应，实现生成式图像编辑场景下可靠的来源归属与无需原图的盲编辑定位。
en_tdlr: ReliaGuard is a reconstruction-aware watermarking framework that jointly optimizes keyed feature responses on both the protected image and its VAE reconstruction, enabling reliable source attribution and blind edit localization for generative image editing.
